<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
import re
def player_pos():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    # player = blue node with orange cap on top; find blue 'b' node
    best=None
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']
            rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            # top-left of bounding box
            best=(min(rs),min(cs))
    return best
seq=['UP','RIGHT','UP','UP','UP','UP','UP','RIGHT','RIGHT','DOWN','RIGHT','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN']
expected=[(40,29),(35,29),(35,34),(30,34),(25,34),(20,34),(15,34),(10,34),(10,39),(10,44),(15,44),(15,49),(20,49),(25,49),(30,49),(35,49),(40,49),(45,49)]
print("start", player_pos())
for i,mv in enumerate(seq):
    action([mv])
    if last_action_result.get('game_over') or last_action_result.get('run_complete') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print("STOP after",i,mv,last_action_result); break
    p=player_pos()
    ok = (p==expected[i+1])
    print(i,mv,"->",p,"exp",expected[i+1],"OK" if ok else "MISMATCH")
    if not ok:
        print("blocked/mismatch, stopping"); break
print("final pos", player_pos())
# check pickup: is white plus gone? is player now carrying orange key?
seg=current_frame.segmentation
colors={}
for n in seg['nodes']:
    colors[n['color']]=colors.get(n['color'],0)+n['pixels']
print("color pixels:", {k:v for k,v in sorted(colors.items())})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
